name: Anna
source:
Anna is an antique doll [url=/c12330]Romeo[/url] found in a trash dump. She had lost all her memories. She works in [url=/c12361]Germano[/url]’s workshop, fixing machines and making orgels. She’s a bright, lively and hilarious character that takes care of Romeo.

[Edited from a [url=http://accany.wordpress.com/2010/01/20/月光のカルネヴァーレ-review/]review[/url] by Accany]
